questions.label: Predict the first line of output (without surrounding quotes).
questions.prompt:
points = 10
bonus = points + 2
points = 20
print(points)
print(bonus)

First output line: ___
questions.explain: After line 1, points is 10. Line 2 calculates 12 and stores it as bonus. Line 3 reassigns points to 20 but does not recalculate bonus. Keep a small table of names and current values when tracing assignments.
